notes: The last digit of the year is lost ('163 ..'). The era is not named. VS is assumed because the copy was made at Kāśī and dated with plain 'saṃvat', which gives c. 1573–1582 CE. If the era were Śaka, the date would be c. 1711–1720 CE. Trivikramagiri is probably a Daśanāmī ascetic of the Giri order (the name could also be read as Trivikrama + Giri). The catalogue's scribe field (Kṛṣṇa) agrees with the colophon.
